scope: Raw copy of the private git directory of one retired worktree, kept because it carries a commit that is absent from the canonical repository and cannot be exported as a patch. Nothing here is active code and nothing here is imported by the package.

orphan_commit.subject: Represent changed-history UV remainder quantities and bind them
orphan_commit.author: Kodareken Douglas <douglas@swedishsoftwareengineers.com>
orphan_commit.why_no_patch: format-patch needs the parent to compute a diff, and the parent object was stored only in the macOS repository that this machine does not have.

second_ref.state: ref only; its objects were reached through a macOS alternate path and are not in this directory

layout.git-nsc-raw/: byte copy of the .git-nsc directory, 80 files, about 2.3 MB
layout.git-nsc-raw/config.original: the config as found; it names worktree /Users/admin/Projects/BlackHoles-Infinity-Worktrees/nsc-current-uv-core and an alternate object path under /Users/admin, neither of which exists here

recovery_attempt: git --git-dir=git-nsc-raw --work-tree=. cat-file -p adec987b0ede76baebaff01b0c0e9b43bcd5ca37 reads the commit header and its tree. Traversing to a diff fails on the absent parent.
relation_to_the_live_campaign: The worktree held no working file that the canonical checkout or the pre-closure archive lacks. This commit is a snapshot in the paused local incoming gate campaign, not a new result, and it does not reopen the gate.
